businesses.business: payment and invoice processing and bank holding

offering_description.value: Processes and pays freight, utility, telecom and waste invoices on behalf of large enterprises, and provides expense data management and analytics. Also operates a commercial bank serving businesses, churches and faith-based ministries with deposits and loans.

primary_services.value: freight invoice payment and audit; utility invoice processing; telecom expense management; waste invoice processing; commercial banking and church lending

customer_segment.value: B2B: large corporations and institutions with high invoice volumes, churches and ministries, small businesses

end_markets.value: transportation and logistics; utilities and energy; telecommunications; waste services; religious institutions

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-invoice and payment processing fees; interest or premiums: net interest on loans and investments funded by payment float and deposits; service fees: bank service charges and data management fees
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in supplier invoices from enterprise clients, pays suppliers and delivers data to clients; financial intermediary: bank taking deposits and lending to churches and businesses

geography_served.value: North America: Mainly US, with processing for clients in Canada and Europe, bank in US states such as Missouri, Colorado and Florida

specialization.value: related lines: invoice payment processing and related commercial banking

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to enterprise clients and churches

regulatory_exposure.value: high: bank holding company regulated by the Federal Reserve, FDIC and state banking regulators, payment rules
